schedule_and_ledger_contract: Revalidate immutable problem, reservoir, schedule and segment snapshots through data constructors at each public entry; do not call prior numerical methods.
Canonical finite schedule coordinates exactly tile the requested support. The CLI independently checks raw JSON decimal support before float projection.
Logical step time is exact rational start+(stop-start)*step/steps, with a rounded time_s stamp and reconstructible segment indices.
Every stage of the old segment uses old power; the next segment begins with new power and one carried boundary state.
Release, input, removal, internal, translation and gross wall debit are independently accumulated; exact signed net thermal balance may vanish without erasing gross positive channels.
Adsorbate reference is -D*N, with D independent of Ea0. Number, input, allocation, bound-reference, gross-channel and total residuals remain separately signed.
Area multiplies each areal number/energy/residual exactly once after areal evolution.

checks.finding: API snapshots reconstruct validated problem data, reject Ea0<=0 and retain the originally supplied Nref. The exact Fraction complement 1-alpha*N/Nref rejects negative effective barriers.

Exact rational beta is checked in [0,4096] before evaluation. Beta zero returns exactly one; positive suppression must resolve below one. A fixed Decimal50 context has explicit rounding, exponent bounds and traps.
History identifies the Decimal exponential as a numerical approximation and rejects physical-cap or certified-error interpretations. The supported beta interval applies to evaluated nonempty states.
Each direct RK4 stage recomputes the Arrhenius factor from its own N and T. No maintained-temperature or analytic thermal trajectory substitutes for either evolved variable.
Activation energy affects only the kinetic factor. Wall debit is release times independently supplied removal D, internal I and expected translation 2*kB*T.

The Decimal factor is retained as a Fraction through dt*nu*N, SI costs, signed net thermal increment and RK weights. Exact-zero thermal balance leaves gross positive input and removal channels distinct.

Original negative Real inputs reject before conversion. Nonzero projection underflow/overflow, positive cumulative stagnation, lost signed state changes, exhaustion, unsupported state stages and nonadvancing times reject without clipping.

Revalidated schedule data require exact finite tiling. Logical times use Fraction segment differences and local step counts. All stages in one segment use its power; the next segment carries the same state with its new power.
Prescribed input uses a separate exact Fraction finite segment integral and is exposed alongside the integrated gross input and residual.
Bound adsorbate reference energy is -D*N, gas receives internal plus translation, and total residual is thermal plus inventory bound-reference change plus gas minus external input.
Evolution and channels remain per area. Patch area appears once only in extensive sample projections.
Only immutable parameter/schedule records and their data validators are reused. No earlier numerical source evolution, spectral/state chemistry, gap, host, MHD or owner method is called.

limits: Static scientific/domain/interface source inspection only.
Decimal50 exponential is approximate; no certified error or physical beta cap.
Separate tests, manufactured trajectories and independent reference must supply numerical evidence.
No physical water/material/state-chemistry, host, gap or MHD acceptance.

numeric_method.scope: Fresh positive-activation-energy transformed IVP for four manufactured cases/seven saved trajectories; no numerical core, previous reference or producer imports/calls.
numeric_method.parameter_projection: Problem/schedule coefficients first receive float64 projection, retained by Decimal.from_float or exact Fraction. kB=1.380649e-23 and eV=1.602176634e-19 are declared exact SI decimals.
numeric_method.logical_time: Exact represented Fraction segment endpoints and integer segment/step fractions define support. Rounded time_s stamps are checked separately.
numeric_method.transformation: At each segment start carry the independent reference N_s,T_s, reset local s=0 and Z=T_s+A. N=N_s exp(-s), A=(D+I)/(2kB), b=2kB(N_s-N)/C, T=Z exp(-b)-A. In dimensionless time u=nu*t, ds/du=exp[-Ea0(1-alpha*N/Nref)/(kB*T)] and dZ/du=P exp(b)/(C*nu). Nref remains fixed.
numeric_method.method: Order18/26 truncated Taylor coefficient jets of the transformed(s,Z) equations at80/120digits,2/4 substeps per exact union-grid observation interval. Ordinary series multiplication, reciprocal and exponential recurrences determine coefficients without production RK stages. Reference carries its own state, never producer boundary states.
numeric_method.channels: Number reconstructed fromN_s exp(-s); exact input from represented-Fraction segmented support; D/I from independent release. Translation and gross wall debit are separately integrated positive physical integrands along dense Taylor state using Decimal-generated GL12/18 nodes. Neither is derived from thermal or total residuals. Direct Gamma quadrature supplies a separate count check.
numeric_method.segment_structure: All power jumps split exactly. Only numerical local references reset; physical N,T and channel integrals carry. Off-segment Z is exactly constant; empty inventory has its separate exact heat-only branch.
